arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.request_id,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) holds,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||":"||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed"
select * from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending") or booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings)
select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,substr(o.payload,1,200) p,b.status bs from outbox o left join bookings b using(booking_id) where o.status!="delivered" order by o.event_id

select "nocheckin" k, booking_id v from bookings where status="confirmed" and booking_id not in (select booking_id from checkins) union all select "nohold", booking_id from bookings where status="confirmed" and booking_id not in (select booking_id from holds) union all select "unfunded", booking_id from bookings where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=bookings.booking_id and state="captured")!=1 union all select "holds", flight_id||":"||count(*) from holds group by flight_id union all select "cap", flight_id||":"||capacity from flights
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 150) where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4
select b.flight_id, c.amount_cents, count(*) n from bookings b join charges c using(booking_id) where c.state="captured" group by 1,2
select b.status,b.flight_id,count(*) n, sum(b.booking_id in (select booking_id from holds)) h from bookings b join charges c using(booking_id) where c.state="captured" group by 1,2
